needs.title: Your resume
needs.body: Your current resume (PDF or Word). We use only what’s true in it and anything you add to your profile.

needs.title: Your preferences
needs.body: Target job titles, seniority, locations, remote or on-site, salary expectations, work authorisation and companies to avoid.

needs.title: Portal access
needs.body: The email and job-portal logins we’ll apply with, stored in an encrypted vault, plus your written authorisation to apply on your behalf.

how.dailySub: Every application, with the company, role, date and time in your time zone, job link, status and the exact resume used.
how.tailorSub: Tailoring means emphasising what you’ve really done that matters for this job. It never means inventing.

tailorSteps.title: Read the job description
tailorSteps.body: We pull out the skills, tools and responsibilities the employer is asking for.

tailorSteps.title: Match your real experience
tailorSteps.body: We find the parts of your master profile that prove you can do the job.

tailorSteps.title: Rewrite and reorder
tailorSteps.body: Your summary, skills and bullet points are rewritten around the job’s language, in your market’s resume style.

tailorSteps.title: Check before sending
tailorSteps.body: A validator rejects anything not in your profile, and your specialist reviews the resume before applying.

how.truth: We never add a company, job title, date or skill you don’t have.

ethics.q: Is it okay for someone else to apply on my behalf?
ethics.a: Yes, with your permission. You authorise us in writing during onboarding, you choose the roles and companies, and every application is visible to you as soon as it’s sent.
Some job portals’ terms restrict sharing your account. We show you a plain-language notice about this during onboarding, and you decide whether to go ahead.

ethics.q: Will you ever exaggerate my experience?
ethics.a: No. Tailored resumes only use experience, skills and dates from your master profile. An automatic check blocks anything that isn’t there.
Only your assigned specialist, and only while they’re assigned to you. Every reveal is logged, admins can’t see the values, and you can change or delete them at any time.

ethics.q: Can I stop at any time?
ethics.a: Yes. Cancel from Billing whenever you like. Your plan runs to the end of the period you’ve paid for, and your history stays available to you.

faq.title: Questions from job seekers in India

items.q: I’m serving a 90-day notice period. Is it too early to start?
items.a: No — it’s the best time. Most companies hiring experienced people expect 30–90 days. We put your notice period on every application, and if you can negotiate or buy it out, we say so.

items.q: Do you apply to consultancies or only product companies?
items.a: Whatever mix you choose. Tell us during onboarding — product companies, GCCs, startups, IT services or staffing consultancies — and change it any week from your dashboard.

items.q: Will you apply to my current employer?
items.a: Never. Your current employer, past employers and any company you name go on an exclusion list that every search respects.

items.q: Do you charge anything after I join?
items.a: Only what the Placement Agreement you accept at sign-up says — it’s linked in the footer. The monthly plan is shown above, there are no hidden charges, and your specialist never collects money from you directly.

items.q: Which portals do you use?
items.a: Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed India, Instahyre, Foundit and company career pages. You can add or remove any of them from your dashboard.

items.q: Is interview prep in English?
items.a: Yes — mock interviews and question banks are in English, because that’s how most Indian interviews run. Our team speaks Hindi and several regional languages, so check-ins can be in whichever you prefer.

items.q: What does the daily WhatsApp check-in include?
items.a: On the Standard plan, a message every working day with what was applied, what moved and anything we need from you. Reply any time.
